theorems.name: Submission.adr_eventually_subset_small_cover
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (ℓ : ℝ) (S : Set (Euclid P)) (Ts : ℕ → Set (Euclid P)) (ε : ℝ≥0∞), 0 < ℓ → IsClosed S → μH[ℓ] (S ∩ ball (0 : Euclid P) 1) = 0 → 0 < ε → (∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ k₀ : ℕ, ∀ k ≥ k₀, ball (0 : Euclid P) 1 ∩ Ts k ⊆ {x | ∃ z ∈ S, dist x z < η}) → ∃ (U : ℕ → Set (Euclid P)) (k₀ : ℕ), ∑' j, Metric.ediam (U j) ^ ℓ < ε ∧ ∀ k ≥ k₀, ball (0 : Euclid P) (1 / 2) ∩ Ts k ⊆ ⋃ j, U j
